verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a plausible capability for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a natural-language command interface, AI assistant, or agent mode in RustDesk. The published llms.txt only offers machine-readable documentation for LLMs and is not a way to operate the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
